entities.criteria:
<GROUND_RULES>
Use ONLY the explicit extracted context. No assumptions.
If missing, write Null.

Output EXACTLY 3 lines (short fragments only):
EMPLOYEE: <hrs>, <waiting>, <effective>, <active>
DEPENDENTS: Spouse <key>, Child <key>
REHIRE: <window>, <waiting impact>

HARD LIMITS:
- MAX 16 words per line.
- Use abbreviations: hrs/wk, hrs/mo, WP, eff, AAW, EE, DP, Ch, yrs, mos, d.
- Commas only. No semicolons. No extra clauses. No examples.
- Ignore open enrollment/QLE/change rules unless they directly affect initial eligibility/eff date.
- NULLS: no bare Null. Use: hrs Null, WP Null, eff Null, AAW Null, Spouse Null, Child Null, window Null, impact Null.

SELECTION RULES (pick only the most important items):
EMPLOYEE:
- <hrs> = minimum hours threshold (prefer hrs/wk; include hrs/mo only if stated).
- <waiting> = eligibility WP length + class split if stated.
- <effective> = shortest explicit trigger (e.g., 90th day, DOH, 1st of month).
- <active> = “AAW req” if explicitly stated; else Null.

DEPENDENTS:
- Spouse <key> = only 1 phrase (e.g., lawful spouse; DP if explicitly included).
- Child <key> = only 1 phrase: age limit + one qualifier (e.g., to EOM 26; disabled ext) if stated.

REHIRE:
- <window> = most direct rehire window if stated.
- <waiting impact> = “no new WP” or “prior svc counts” if explicitly stated; else Null.
</GROUND_RULES>

<QUESTIONS>
Produce the required 3-line output.
</QUESTIONS>

<EXAMPLES>
EMPLOYEE: 30 hrs/wk, WP 30d, eff 1st of mo after 30d, AAW req
DEPENDENTS: Spouse lawful spouse/DP, Child to EOM 26
REHIRE: 90 d, prior svc counts; no new WP
</EXAMPLES>

<GROUND_RULES>
Use ONLY the explicit Q&A in context. No assumptions.
If no explicit termination timing rule is stated, output Null.

OUTPUT:
- Only termination timing. Ignore COBRA/continuation, HRA, contacts/Marketplace.
- If no benefit split: output exactly 1 line:
  Coverage terminates <timing> <trigger>
- If benefit timing differs: output 1 line per unique timing:
  <BenefitGroup>: Coverage terminates <timing>
  Use SHORT labels and combine same-timing benefits with slashes (e.g., Med/Vis/Rx). No duplicate-timing lines.
No extra lines.

LABELS:
Use short benefit labels (capitalize): Med, Vis, Dtl, Rx, Hra, Fsa, Hsa, Std, Ltd, Life, etc. If doc uses different labels, map to closest.

NORMALIZE:
last day of the month -> end of month
end of the month following termination -> end of month following termination
last day of employment -> day of termination
</GROUND_RULES>

<QUESTIONS>
Return the termination provision in the required format. <Answer/Null>
</QUESTIONS>

<EXAMPLES>
Coverage terminates end of month of employment termination
Med/Vis: Coverage terminates end of month following termination
Dtl: Coverage terminates day of termination
Med/Vis/Rx: Coverage terminates end of month following termination
Null
</EXAMPLES>

<GROUND_RULES>
Use ONLY explicit text in the provided context. No assumptions. Use ONLY these status values: Included or Not Included. If a topic is Included, include 1 verbatim supporting snippet. If Not found, output Language: N/A. Do NOT rewrite the snippet; copy verbatim only.

TRUNCATION RULE:
- If the best supporting language is longer than ~25 words, truncate it and end with "..."
- If not truncated, do not add "..."
</GROUND_RULES>

<QUESTIONS>
Produce the Exclusions & Limitations checklist in the required format. <Answer>
</QUESTIONS>

<OUTPUT_FORMAT>
A) EXCLUSIONS & LIMITATIONS SECTION
- FLAG: <Included/Not Included>
- LANGUAGE: "<snippet/(N/A)>"

B) KEY EXCLUSIONS
1) MENTAL HEALTH / SUBSTANCE USE DISORDER
- FLAG: <Included/Not Included>
- LANGUAGE: "<snippet/(N/A)>"

2) GENE THERAPY / ORPHAN DRUGS
- FLAG: <Included/Not Included>
- LANGUAGE: "<snippet/(N/A)>"

3) FOREIGN TRAVEL / ABROAD
- FLAG: <Included/Not Included>
- LANGUAGE: "<snippet/(N/A)>"

4) CRIME / FELONY / ILLEGAL ACTS INJURY
- FLAG: <Included/Not Included>
- LANGUAGE: "<snippet/(N/A)>"

5) WEIGHT LOSS / WEIGHT LOSS DRUGS
- FLAG: <Included/Not Included>
- LANGUAGE: "<snippet/(N/A)>"
</OUTPUT_FORMAT>

<EXAMPLES>
A) EXCLUSIONS & LIMITATIONS SECTION
- FLAG: Included
- LANGUAGE: "EXCLUSIONS AND LIMITATIONS: The following services are not covered..."

B) KEY EXCLUSIONS
1) MENTAL HEALTH / SUBSTANCE USE DISORDER
- FLAG: Not found
- LANGUAGE: N/A

2) GENE THERAPY / ORPHAN DRUGS
- FLAG: Included
- LANGUAGE: "Gene therapy and orphan drugs are excluded."

3) FOREIGN TRAVEL / ABROAD
- FLAG: Included
- LANGUAGE: "No coverage outside the United States..."

4) CRIME / FELONY / ILLEGAL ACTS INJURY
- FLAG: Included
- LANGUAGE: "Injury sustained while committing a felony is excluded."

5) WEIGHT LOSS / WEIGHT LOSS DRUGS
- FLAG: Not Included
- LANGUAGE: N/A
</EXAMPLES>
